meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把任意文章或笔记快速变成一个视觉讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有文字资料想做成视频,又不想真人出镜或录屏
copy.tagline_en: Create a visual explainer video from any text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to repurpose written content into video without filming or screen capture

howto.what: 装上后,它会把你的文字做成无人出镜的讲解视频:保存原文、选设计模板、写分镜和脚本、生成配音与音乐,最后渲染成 mp4。不抓网站,画面按场景虚构。
howto.when: 当你贴来一段文章、笔记或主题,要求做成讲解类视频(如概念解析、教程、列表盘点)时触发;目标不明确时会先转给 /hyperframes 判断。不适用于网站或产品宣传视频。

say.text: 把这篇关于复利的文章做成讲解视频
say.note: 这会触发完整制作流程

say.text: 把我在 Notion 里那篇笔记改成新手向的概念解析视频
say.note: 不指定风格时,Claude 会自行选模板和配色

say.text: 做一个“在家种番茄”的教程视频,用男声配音
say.note: 指定男声会覆盖默认的女声

howto.what_en: Claude turns your text into a faceless explainer video: it saves the source, picks a design preset, writes storyboard/script, generates narration and music, builds frames, and renders an MP4. No capture — visuals are invented per scene.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you paste an article or notes and ask for an explainer video (concept breakdown, how-to, listicle). Unclear intent goes to /hyperframes first. Not for website or product promo videos.

say_en.text: Turn this article about compound interest into an explainer video
say_en.note: This starts the full production flow.

say_en.text: Turn my Notion note into a beginner-friendly concept explainer
say_en.note: Without a style pick, Claude chooses the template itself.

say_en.text: Make a 'growing tomatoes at home' tutorial with a male narrator
say_en.note: Specifying male voice overrides the default female.
